First, we calculate $P(B)$ using the addition law:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B) \\ \frac{8}{9} & =\frac{1}{3}+P(B)-\frac{1}{7} \\ P(B) & =\frac{8}{9}+\frac{1}{7}-\frac{1}{3} \\  & =\frac{44}{63}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P({B}^{′}) & =1-P(B) \\  & =1-\frac{44}{63} \\  & =\frac{19}{63}.\end{aligned}
$$
